title: SWos-Config switch configuration
description: Desired-state configuration for a MikroTik SwOS switch, consumed by config2swos.py.

identity.description: System identity / name written to the switch (system.set(identity=...)).

hostname.description: IP address or hostname used to reach the switch. Defaults to 192.168.88.1 if omitted, or overridden by --hostname on the command line.

username.description: Present for documentation purposes only; the script always connects as 'admin' regardless of this value.

has_POE.description: Whether the switch supports PoE. Enables processing of poe_ports and loads the PoE module. Defaults to false, or overridden by --has_POE on the command line.

vlans.description: VLANs to create/ensure exist on the switch.

access_ports.description: Ports carrying a single untagged VLAN.

trunk_ports.description: Ports carrying multiple tagged VLANs, optionally with one untagged (hybrid) VLAN.

bonding_ports.description: LACP-bonded port pairs carrying multiple VLANs, optionally with one untagged (hybrid) VLAN.

poe_ports.description: Per-port PoE output configuration. Only applied when has_POE is true.

portNumber.description: Physical switch port number (SFP/combo ports typically use the higher-numbered interfaces, e.g. 51/52 on a 48-port switch).

lacpMode.description: LACP mode for the port. 'static' requires group_id to also be set.

portSettings.description: Common per-port link settings, merged over ports_defaults (enabled: true, autoneg: true, duplex: false, tx_flow_control: true, rx_flow_control: false, speed: 1000). All are optional overrides.

name.description: Port label. On access/trunk ports this is prefixed with the port number and truncated to 16 characters by the switch.

duplex.description: true = half duplex, false = full duplex (per mikrotik_swos convention).

group_id.description: LACP group id. Required when mode is 'static'.

vlan_id.description: The single untagged VLAN this port belongs to. Also used as the port's default VLAN ID.

vlans.description: Tagged VLANs carried on this trunk.

untagged_vlan.description: If set, makes this a hybrid trunk: this VLAN is received untagged (receive_mode 'any') and is also added to the trunk's VLAN membership. If omitted, the port only accepts tagged frames (receive_mode 'only tagged').

name.description: Name applied directly to both bonded ports (not prefixed/truncated like access/trunk port names).

vlans.description: Tagged VLANs carried on this LACP bond.

untagged_vlan.description: If set, makes this a hybrid bond: this VLAN is received untagged on both member ports and added to the bond's VLAN membership.

group_id.description: LACP group id. Required when mode is 'static'.

priority.description: PoE priority, used when the power budget is exceeded.
